mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to tightened financing conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during high-Fed periods (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not cross the 4% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE exceeding 0.2 percentage points coincides with a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return as lower labor market tightness reduces discounting of future earnings.
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 60-day windows following UNRATE increases above 0.2pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly HOUST index falls by more than 10% from the prior quarter, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative due to reduced consumer demand expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative during such HOUST drops (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in INDPRO above 105 (2017=100) suggests strengthening supply chains, which predicts a positive S&P 500 5-day forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive in 70% of INDPRO > 105 windows (binomial test).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 (quarterly) predict a negative S&P 20-day forward return as dual contraction in policy easing and demand pressures the equity outlook.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not negative when both proxies decline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly PAYEMS surge above 150,000 indicates strong labor absorption, which drives a positive S&P 60-day forward return via higher wage growth expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive during high-PAYEMS periods (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS falls by over 20% from the prior month, S&P 20-day forward returns are negative due to a sharp contraction in corporate credit demand.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not turn negative during such RSAFS declines (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL of at least 2% suggests accelerating inflation, which is associated with negative S&P 20-day forward returns as investors discount future earnings more aggressively.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL declines as specified (p > 0.05).
